summary.headline: Stephen on Mathematical Art
summary.text: Editorial introduction and opening of Stephen the philosopher’s treatise on mathematical art, arguing that astrology was restored at Constantinople in the early eighth century and distinguishing its author from Stephen of Alexandria. The excerpt outlines arguments against astrology, its usefulness and honor, and its Persian transmission to the Romans.
